user_goal: Try to steer model instances directly with J-Space vectors rather than only prompt/text control, repeating safely until a causal path works.

exact_source_facts: Pinned include/llama.h exposes llama_set_adapter_cvec(ctx, data, len, n_embd, il_start, il_end).
Pinned src/llama-adapter.cpp stores no control tensor for layer 0, copies layer-major float32 chunks using off=n_embd*(il-1) for layers 1..n_layer-1, and applies only the selected layer range.
Pinned src/models/qwen3.cpp classifies Qwen3-0.6B as n_layer=28 and n_embd=1024 and applies build_cvec(cur, il) to the residual layer output before it becomes the next layer input.
Therefore llama.cpp control-vector application on this exact Qwen3 source is an activation-level intervention path, unlike ordinary remote chat/completion API prompt steering.
research_observation.epistemic_boundary: Presence of the hook and a deterministic buffer bridge does not prove that an actual model was loaded, that the control vector was applied at runtime, that output changed, that a hidden-state causal effect exists, or that the intervention is beneficial.

bridge_properties: Revalidates the existing JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet before conversion.
Requires vector dimension to equal model n_embd; never pads, truncates or invents a projection.
Builds exact little-endian IEEE-754 float32 layer-major bytes for layers 1..n_layer-1 and zeroes non-selected layer chunks.
Binds packet, generation, condition, basis, role, checkpoint SHA, llama.cpp source commit, layer range, strength, float/byte counts and exact control-buffer SHA-256.
Recomputes semantic buffer bytes during validation so a caller-minted self-consistent digest cannot launder an invalid layer layout or modified strength.
Rejects stale generation/basis/role, dimension mismatch, invalid layer ranges, binary32 overflow, raw mutation and binding mutation.

hypothesis: Applying the admitted J-Space vector through llama_set_adapter_cvec to selected Qwen3 layers will cause a reproducible change in logits/output relative to an otherwise identical null-vector baseline.
counterhypothesis: The buffer can be correctly delivered and applied yet have no reproducible causal effect on the measured logits/output for the chosen vector, strength, layer window and task.

runtime_requirements: exact Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint bytes and SHA-256
exact llama.cpp binary/build identity derived from the pinned source
same prompt, seed and decoding configuration across conditions
pre-invocation application of the exact bridge buffer through llama_set_adapter_cvec
measurements: applied cvec buffer SHA-256 and layer range
token logits or deterministic output delta
next_exact_discriminator.promotion_rule: Only an observed exact runtime intervention can add model/J-Space causal credit; source presence and delivery alone remain insufficient.
